title: Pojačani polasci zbog verskog praznika Zadušnice

sections.text: JGSP „Novi Sad“ obaveštava korisnike usluga da će u subotu, 7. novembra, zbog verskog praznika Zadušnice na liniji broj 14 biti angažovani zglobni autobusi. Pojačani polasci biće i na liniji za Čenej u 10:30 i 11:45 časova.

text_translations.en: JGSP "Novi Sad" informs service users that on Saturday, November 7, due to the religious holiday of Remembrance, articulated buses will be engaged on route number 14. There will be increased departures on the line to Chennai at 10:30 and 11:45.

sections.text: Autobusi na linijama broj 53 i 55 na polascima iz Novog Sada u 8:40, 9:50, 10:50, 11:55, 13:10 i 15:30) časova saobraćaće do groblja Futog (povratak u 9:30, 10:35, 11:40, 12:45, 14:00 i 16:20 časova).

text_translations.en: Buses on lines 53 and 55 departing from Novi Sad at 8:40 a.m., 9:50 a.m., 10:50 a.m., 11:55 a.m., 1:10 p.m. and 3:30 p.m. will drive to the Futog cemetery (returns at 9:30 a.m., 10:35 a.m., 11:40 a.m., 12:45 p.m., 2:00 p.m. and 4:20 p.m.).

title_translations.en: Increased departures due to the religious holiday of Remembrance

title: Produžetak linije 18A do železničkog stajališta Rumenački put (polazak u 00:30 časova)

sections.text: Autobusi na liniji 18A od 6. 11. (trajna izmena) na polasku u 00:30 časova saobraćaće produženo do stajališta na Rumenačkom putu.

text_translations.en: Buses on route 18A from 11/6 (permanent change) departing at 00:30 will run extended until the stop on Rumenački put.

sections.text: Na navedenom polasku autobusi će sa dosadašnje trase iz Ulice Kornelija Stankovića skretati levo na Rumenački put do TPS železničkog stajališta i u 00:45 časova nastaviti preko kružnog toka i Rumenačkim putem, odakle će se vraćati na redovnu trasu u Ulicu Kornelija Stankovića.

text_translations.en: At the mentioned departure, the buses will turn left from the current route from Kornelija Stankovića Street to Rumenački put to the TPS railway stop and at 00:45 they will continue through the roundabout and Rumenački put, from where they will return to the regular route to Kornelija Stankovića Street.

title_translations.en: Extension of line 18A to the Rumenački put railway station (departure at 00:30)

title: Linija 8 – Privremena izmena trase na Novom naselju

sections.text: Zbog radova na rekonstrukciji kolovoza u Ulici Bate Brkića, od 9. do 27. novembra privremeno se izmešta trasa autobuske linije broj 8 u oba smera.

text_translations.en: Due to road reconstruction works in Bata Brkića Street, from November 9 to 27, the route of bus line number 8 will be temporarily moved in both directions.

sections.text: Autobusi će umesto Ulicom Bate Brkića, Bulevarom vojvode Stepe i Bulevarom kneza Miloša saobraćati pravo Bulevarom Jovana Dučića ka okretnici.

text_translations.en: Instead of Bata Brkića Street, Vojvoda Stepa Boulevard and Knez Milos Boulevard, the buses will drive straight along Jovan Dučić Boulevard towards the turnpike.

sections.text: Na izmenjenom delu trase koristiće se postojeća stalajišta drugih autobuskih linija.

text_translations.en: Existing stops of other bus lines will be used on the changed part of the route.

title_translations.en: Line 8 – Temporary change of the route in Novi naselje

title: Linija 52 – Privremena izmena trase u Veterniku

sections.text: U skladu sa rešenjem Gradske uprave za saobraćaj i puteve, od 4. do 11. novembra 2026. godine privremeno će biti izmenjena trasa autobuske linije broj 52 zbog radova u Ulici vojvode Bojovića u Veterniku.

text_translations.en: In accordance with the decision of the City Administration for Traffic and Roads, from November 4 to 11, 2026, the route of bus line number 52 will be temporarily changed due to works in Vojvoda Bojovića Street in Veternik.

sections.text: Na raskrsnici Tome Maksimovića/Kralja Petra I autobusi će skretati levo u Ulicu kralja Petra I i saobraćati do kružne raskrsnice, izlaziće na prvom izlazu u Ulicu kralja Aleksandra do Školske ulice, skretati levo u Školsku ulicu i na prvom stajalištu „VETERNIK-ŠKOLA“ (bivše polazno stajalište linije 52) čekaće se vreme do polaska za Novi Sad.

text_translations.en: At the Toma Maksimović/Kralja Petra I intersection, buses will turn left into Kralja Petra I Street and travel to the roundabout, exit at the first exit into Kralja Aleksandra Street to Školska Street, turn left into Školska Street and at the first stop "VETERNIK-ŠKOLA" (former departure stop of line 52) wait for the departure time for Novi Sad.

sections.text: NA IZMENjENOM DELU TRASE KORISTIĆE SE STAJALIŠTA DRUGIH LINIJA.

text_translations.en: STOPS OF OTHER LINES WILL BE USED ON THE CHANGED PART OF THE ROUTE.

sections.text: Polasci za Novi Sad započinjaće sa stajališta „VETERNIK-ŠKOLA“, odakle će autobusi saobraćati redovnom trasom kretanja.

text_translations.en: Departures to Novi Sad will start from the "VETERNIK-SCHOLA" stop, from where buses will run on a regular route.

title_translations.en: Line 52 – Temporary route change in Veternik

title: Linije 1,17,21,22,23,24,30 – Privremena izmena trase u Kisačkoj ulici od 2. 11. (druga faza radova)

sections.text: U skladu sa rešenjem Gradske uprave za saobraćaj i puteve, od 2.11. do 30.11.2026. godine određuje se privremena izmena trase autobuskih linija broj 1, 17, 21, 22, 22, 23, 24 i 30 zbog radova u Kisačkoj ulici, na delu od Ulice Jovana Cvijića do Bulevara kralja Petra I.

text_translations.en: In accordance with the decision of the City Administration for Traffic and Roads, dated 2.11. until 30.11.2026. 1, 17, 21, 22, 22, 23, 24 and 30, due to works in Kisačka Street, on the part from Jovana Cvijić Street to Kralja Petar I Boulevard.

sections.text: LINIJA 1

text_translations.en: LINE 1

sections.text: Na raskrsnici  Kisačka/Bulevar Jaše Tomića autobusi će skretati desno na Bulevar Jaše Tomića, levo na Bulevar oslobođenja, levo  na Bulevar kralja Petra I i desno Kisačkom ulicom nastavljaće redovnom trasom.

text_translations.en: At the intersection of Kisačka/Jaša Tomić Boulevard, buses will turn right onto Jaša Tomić Boulevard, left onto Oslobođenja Boulevard, left onto Kralja Petar I Boulevard and right onto Kisačka Street and continue on their regular route.

sections.text: NA IZMENЈENOM DELU TRASE KORISTIĆE SE STAJALIŠTE  „BULEVAR OSLOBOĐENЈA -  BULEVAR JAŠE TOMIĆA“ (KOD PEKARE „KLAS“).

text_translations.en: ON THE MODIFIED PART OF THE ROUTE, THE "BOULEVARD OSLOBOĖENJA - BULEVAR JAŠA TOMIĆA" STOP WILL BE USED (NEAR THE "KLAS" BAKERY).

sections.text: Na raskrsnici Kisačka/Bulevar kralja Petra I autobusi će skretati levo na Bulevar kralja Petra I, desno na Bulevar oslobođenja, desno na Bulevar Jaše Tomića, levo u Kisačku ulicu, odakle će nastavljati redovnom trasom.

text_translations.en: At the Kisačka/Kralja Petra I Boulevard intersection, buses will turn left onto Kralja Petra I Boulevard, right onto Oslobođenja Boulevard, right onto Jaša Tomić Boulevard, left into Kisačka Street, from where they will continue on their regular route.

sections.text: NA IZMENЈENOM DELU TRASE KORISTIĆE SE STAJALIŠTE  BULEVAR KRALЈA PETRA I – KISAČKA.

text_translations.en: ON THE CHANGED PART OF THE ROUTE, THE KING PETRA I BOULEVARD - KISAČKA STOP WILL BE USED.

sections.text: LINIJA 17

text_translations.en: LINE 17

sections.text: Na raskrsnici Kisačka/Bulevar Jaše Tomića autobusi će skretati desno na Bulevar Jaše Tomića, levo na Bulevar oslobođenja, levo  na Bulevar kralja Petra I i desno Kisačkom ulicom nastavljaće redovnom trasom.

text_translations.en: At the intersection of Kisačka/Jaša Tomić Boulevard, buses will turn right onto Jaša Tomić Boulevard, left onto Oslobođenja Boulevard, left onto Kralja Petar I Boulevard and right onto Kisačka Street and continue on their regular route.

sections.text: NA IZMENJENOM DELU TRASE KORISTIĆE SE STAJALIŠTE „BULEVAR OSLOBOĐENЈA -  BULEVAR JAŠE TOMIĆA“ (kod pekare „Klas“).

text_translations.en: ON THE CHANGED PART OF THE ROUTE, THE "BOULEVARD OSLOBOĖENJA - BULEVAR JAŠA TOMIĆA" STOP WILL BE USED (near the "Klas" bakery).

sections.text: Redovna trasa.

text_translations.en: Regular route.

sections.text: Sa platoa ispred železničke stanice autobusi će skretati levo na Bulevar Jaše Tomića, levo u Kisačku ulicu, desno u Partizansku, raskrsnici Partizanska/Temerinska produžavaće pravo Putem Šajkaškog odreda i nastavljati redovnim trasama.

text_translations.en: From the plateau in front of the railway station, the buses will turn left onto Bulevar Jaše Tomić, left into Kisačka Street, right into Partizanska, the Partizanska/Temerinska intersection will continue straight along Šajkaški Detachment Road and continue on regular routes.

sections.text: Autobusi će saobraćati redovnim trasama do raskrsnice Partizanska/Temerinska, odakle će produžavati pravo Partizanskom ulicom, skretati levo u Kisačku ulicu, desno na Bulevar Jaše Tomića do železničke stanice.

text_translations.en: Buses will run on regular routes to the intersection of Partizanska/Temerinska, from where they will continue straight along Partizanska Street, turn left into Kisačka Street, right onto Bulevar Jaše Tomić to the train station.

sections.text: NA IZMENJENOM DELU TRASE KORISTIĆE SE POSTOJEĆA AUTOBUSKA STAJALIŠTA DRUGIH LINIJA.

text_translations.en: EXISTING BUS STOPS OF OTHER LINES WILL BE USED ON THE CHANGED PART OF THE ROUTE.

sections.text: LINIJA 30

text_translations.en: LINE 30

sections.text: Polazno stajalište Bulevar Jaše Tomića, odakle će autobusi skretati levo u Kisačku ulicu, desno u Partizansku, levo u Temerinsku ulicu i nastavljati redovnom trasom za Pejićeve salaše.

text_translations.en: Departure stop Bulevar Jaša Tomić, from where the buses will turn left into Kisačka ulica, right into Partizanska ulica, left into Temerinska ulica and continue on the regular route to Pejićeve salaše.

sections.text: Autobusi će saobraćati redovnom trasom do raskrsnice Partizanska/Temerinska, skretaće desno u Partizansku ulicu, levo u Kisačku ulicu, desno na Bulevar Jaše Tomića do železničke stanice.

text_translations.en: Buses will run on the regular route to the Partizanska/Temerinska intersection, turn right into Partizanska Street, left into Kisačka Street, right onto Bulevar Jaše Tomić to the train station.

sections.text: NA IZMENJENOM DELU TRASE KORISTIĆE SE POSTOJEĆA AUTOBUSKA STAJALIŠTA DRUGIH LINIJA.

text_translations.en: EXISTING BUS STOPS OF OTHER LINES WILL BE USED ON THE CHANGED PART OF THE ROUTE.

title_translations.en: Lines 1, 17, 21, 22, 23, 24, 30 – Temporary change of the route in Kisacka street from 2 November (second phase of works)

title: Linije 6, 11A, 11B – Privremena izmena trase u Ulici Marka Miljanova (2. faza)

sections.text: U skladu sa rešenjem Gradske uprave za saobraćaj i puteve o zatvaranju dela Ulice Marka Miljanova i Kisačke ulice (2. faza radova), od 2. do 16. novembra privremeno se menjaju trase autobuskih linija 6, 11A i 11B na sledeći način:

text_translations.en: In accordance with the decision of the City Administration for Traffic and Roads on the closure of the part of Marka Miljanova Street and Kisačka Street (2nd phase of works), from November 2 to 16, the routes of bus lines 6, 11A and 11B will be temporarily changed as follows:

sections.text: LINIJA 6

text_translations.en: LINE 6

sections.text: Autobusi će iz Ulice Filipa Višnjića skretati desno u Venizelosovu ulicu, desno pored Kvantaša saobraćati do kružnog toka, skretati levo u Ulicu Marka Miljanova, desno na Begradski kej i dalje nastavljati redovnom trasom.

text_translations.en: Buses will turn right from Filipa Višnjić Street to Venizelosova Street, drive right past Kvantaš to the roundabout, turn left to Marka Miljanova Street, right to Begradski Quay and continue along the regular route.

sections.text: Redovna trasa.

text_translations.en: Regular route.

sections.text: LINIJA 11A

text_translations.en: LINE 11A

sections.text: Autobusi će sa Beogradskog keja nastavljati pravo i nakon drumsko-železničkog mosta  skretati levo u Venizelosovu ulicu, desno u Temerinsku ulicu, levo u Partizansku ulicu, levo u Kisačku ulicu, desno na Bulevar Jaše Tomića i dalje nastavljati redovnom trasom.

text_translations.en: Buses will continue straight from Beogradski Quay and after the road-railway bridge will turn left into Venizelosova Street, right into Temerinska Street, left into Partizanska Street, left into Kisačka Street, right onto Jaša Tomić Boulevard and continue along the regular route.

sections.text: Na izmenjenom delu trase koristiće se  stajališta „BEOGRADSKI KEJ - MARKA MILjANOVA“ na Beogradskom keju i „PARTIZANSKA – TEMERINSKA“ u Partizanskoj ulici.

text_translations.en: On the changed part of the route, the stops "BELGRADE QUAY - MARKA MILJANOVA" on Belgrade Quay and "PARTIZANSKA - TEMERINSKA" in Partizanska Street will be used.

sections.text: LINIJA 11B

text_translations.en: LINE 11B

sections.text: Autobusi će sa platoa ispred železničke stanice skretati levo na Bulevar Jaše Tomića, levo u Kisačku ulicu, desno u Partizansku ulicu, na raskrsnici Partizanska/Temerinska skretati  desno u Temerinsku ulicu, zatim levo u Venizelosovu ulicu, desno pored Kvantaša saobraćati do kružnog toka, skretati levo u Ulicu Marka Miljanova, desno na Begradski kej i dalje nastavljati redovnom trasom.

text_translations.en: From the plateau in front of the railway station, the buses will turn left onto Bulevar Jaša Tomić, left into Kisačka Street, right into Partizanska Street, at the Partizanska/Temerinska intersection, turn right into Temerinska Street, then left into Venizelosova Street, right past Kvantaš, drive to the roundabout, turn left into Marka Miljanova Street, right onto Begradski Quay and continue along the regular route.

sections.text: Na izmenjenom delu trase koristiće se stajališta drugih linija do povratka na redovnu trasu („KISAČKA – PODVOŽNjAK“ u Kisačkoj ulici, „TEMERINSKA – PARTIZANSKA“ u Temerinskoj ulici).

text_translations.en: On the changed part of the route, the stops of other lines will be used until the return to the regular route ("KISAČKA - PODVOŽNJAK" in Kisacka Street, "TEMERINSKA - PARTIZANSKA" in Temerinska Street).

title_translations.en: Lines 6, 11A, 11B – Temporary change of route in Marka Miljanova Street (2nd phase)

title: Ukidaju se vanredni polasci do i od Železničke stanice Petrovaradin

sections.text: Nakon otvaranja železničkog stajališta na Rumenačkom putu i rasterećenja Železničke stanice Petrovaradin, raskinut je ugovor između „Srbijavoza“ i JGSP „Novi Sad“ o organizovanju besplatnih vanrednih polazaka autobusa na relaciji Šafarikova ulica – Železnička stanica Petrovaradin.

text_translations.en: After the opening of the railway stop on Rumenački put and the relief of Petrovaradin Railway Station, the contract between "Srbijavoza" and JGSP "Novi Sad" on organizing free emergency bus departures on the route Šafarikova Street - Petrovaradin Railway Station was terminated.

sections.text: Shodno tome, od 12. oktobra ukidaju se vanredni direktni polasci autobusa sa redovnog stajališta „Petrovaradin – Železnička stanica“, u Preradovićevoj ulici, do terminala u Šafarikovoj ulici u centru Novog Sada (oba smera).

text_translations.en: Accordingly, as of October 12, extraordinary direct bus departures from the regular "Petrovaradin - Railway Station" stop in Preradovićeva Street to the terminal in Šafarikova Street in the center of Novi Sad will be canceled (both directions).

sections.text: Putnici i dalje mogu da koriste redovne polaske na linijama 3, 9, 9A, 60, 61, 62 i 63 za dolazak do Železničke stanice Petrovaradin.

text_translations.en: Passengers can still use regular departures on lines 3, 9, 9A, 60, 61, 62 and 63 to get to Petrovaradin Railway Station.

title_translations.en: Extraordinary departures to and from Petrovaradin Railway Station are cancelled

title: Linija 4 produžena do železničkog stajališta Rumenački put

sections.text: Od 7. oktobra  trasa linije 4 produžava se do Rumenačkog puta, čime je građanima omogućena direktna veza javnim prevozom do železničkog stajališta Rumenački put.

text_translations.en: From October 7th, the route of line 4 is extended to Rumenački put, which enables citizens to have a direct connection by public transport to the railway stop Rumenački put.

sections.text: Autobusi na liniji će sa Bulevara oslobođenja nastavljati Bulevarom Jaše Tomića, Rumenačkom ulicom i Rumenačkim putem do železničkog stajališta Rumenački put. Ista trasa koristi se i u suprotnom smeru.

text_translations.en: Buses on the line will continue from the Boulevard of Liberation to the Boulevard of Jaša Tomić, Rumenački street and Rumenački put to the railway stop Rumenački put. The same route is used in the opposite direction.

sections.text: Na produženom delu trase koriste se postojeća stajališta, a uvedeno je i novo stajalište u okviru parking zone železničkog stajališta Rumenački put.

text_translations.en: On the extended part of the route, the existing stops are used, and a new stop was introduced within the parking zone of the Rumenački put railway station.

sections.text: Sa izmenom trase promenjen je i naziv linije, koja sada saobraća pod nazivom LIMAN 4 – CENTAR – Železnička stanica (Rumenački put).

text_translations.en: With the change of the route, the name of the line was also changed, which now runs under the name LIMAN 4 - CENTAR - Railway station (Rumenački put).

sections.text: Produžavanjem linije 4 unapređuje se povezanost nove Železničke stanice sa centralnim gradskim područjem, kao i sa drugim važnim gradskim pravcima. Linija povezuje više značajnih odredišta, među kojima su Futoška pijaca, Bulevar Mihajla Pupina i područje Novosadskog univerziteta.

text_translations.en: The extension of line 4 improves the connection of the new railway station with the central city area, as well as with other important city routes. The line connects several important destinations, including the Futoška market, Mihajla Pupina Boulevard and the area of ​​the University of Novi Sad.

sections.text: Izmena trase doprinosi boljoj dostupnosti javnog prevoza za građane koji koriste železnički prevoz, a dodatno unapređuje prevoznu uslugu za stanovnike Avijatičarskog naselja i mogućnosti putovanja ka Univerzitetu.

text_translations.en: The route change contributes to better availability of public transport for citizens who use rail transport, and additionally improves the transport service for the residents of Avijatičarski settlement and the possibility of traveling to the University.

sections.text: Pored linije 4, do novog železničkog stajališta Rumenački put građani mogu da koriste i linije 5, 14, 41, 42 i 43.

text_translations.en: In addition to line 4, citizens can also use lines 5, 14, 41, 42 and 43 to reach the new railway stop Rumenački put.

title_translations.en: Line 4 extended to the railway stop Rumenački put

title: Linije 5, 10 APT, 14, 41, 42, 43 – Privremeno ukidanje stajališta RUMENAČKA – RADNIČKO IGRALIŠTE

sections.text: U skladu sa rešenjem Gradske Uprave za saobraćaj i puteve Grada Novog Sada, od 9. 9. 2026. godine do završetka radova privremeno će biti ukinuto autobusko stajalište Rumenačka – Radničko igralište zbog izvođenja građevinskih radova. Navedeno stajalište koriste linije broj 5, 10 APT, 14, 41, 42, 43 – smer ka Sajlovu).

text_translations.en: In accordance with the decision of the City Administration for Traffic and Roads of the City of Novi Sad, from September 9, 2026, until the completion of the works, the bus stop Rumenačka - Radničko igraštet will be temporarily closed due to construction works. The mentioned stop is used by lines number 5, 10 APT, 14, 41, 42, 43 - direction to Saylov).

title_translations.en: Lines 5, 10 APT, 14, 41, 42, 43 - Temporary cancellation of the stop RUMENAČKA - RADNIČKO IGRALISTE

title: Linije 12, 60, 61, 62, 63, 64, 69 i 71vmč – Privremena izmena trasa u Ulici Maksima Gorkog

sections.text: U skladu sa rešenjem Gradske uprave za saobraćaj i puteve, određuje se privremena izmena trase autobuskih linija broj 12, 60, 61, 62, 63, 64, 69 i 71vmč  zbog izvođenja radova na rekonstrukciji kolektora kanalizacione mreže  u Maksima Gorkog, od Stražilovske ulice do Sutjeske ulice u Novom Sadu. Izmenjen  režim saobraćnja linija važi u periodu od 7. 9. do 20. 11. 2026. godine.

text_translations.en: In accordance with the decision of the City Administration for Traffic and Roads, a temporary change in the route of bus lines number 12, 60, 61, 62, 63, 64, 69 and 71vmč is determined due to the performance of works on the reconstruction of the sewer network collector in Maksim Gorko, from Stražilovska Street to Sutjeska Street in Novi Sad. Izmenjen  režim saobraćnja linija važi u periodu od 7. 9. do 20. 11. 2026. godine.

sections.text: LINIJA 12

text_translations.en: LINE 12

sections.text: Autobusi saobraćaju redovnom trasom kretanja.

text_translations.en: Buses operate on a regular route.

sections.text: Autobusi na raskrsnici Bulevar oslobođenja/Ulice Maksima Gorkog produžavaju pravo Bulevarom oslobođenja, skreću desno u Jevrejsku ulicu, levo u Uspensku ulicu i dalje nastavljaju redovnom trasom.

text_translations.en: Buses at the intersection Bulevar oslobodenja/Ulica Maksima Gorki continue straight along Bulevar oslobodenja, turn right into Jevrejska ulica, left into Uspenska ulica and continue on the regular route.

sections.text: NA IZMENJENOM DELU TRASE KORISTE SE POSTOJEĆA STAJALIŠTA DRUGIH LINIJA.

text_translations.en: EXISTING STOPS OF OTHER LINES ARE USED ON THE MODIFIED PART OF THE ROUTE.

sections.text: Autobusi sa Bulevara oslobođenja skreću levo u Jevrejsku ulicu, desno na Bulevar Mihajla Pupina i dalje produžavaju pravo redovnom trasom.

text_translations.en: Buses from Liberation Boulevard turn left into Jevrejska Street, right onto Mihajla Pupina Boulevard and continue straight along the regular route.

sections.text: (NAVEDENOM TRASOM  ĆE SAOBRAĆATI AUTOBUS NA LINIJI 71, SAMO POLAZAK U 21:05vmč)

text_translations.en: (THE LINE 71 BUS WILL RUN ON THIS ROUTE, ONLY DEPARTURES AT 9:05 PM)

sections.text: Autobusi saobraćaju redovnom trasom kretanja.

text_translations.en: Buses operate on a regular route.

sections.text: AUTOBUSI NA IZMENJENOM DELU TRASE  KORISTE POSTOJEĆA STAJALIŠTA DRUGIH LINIJA.

text_translations.en: BUSES ON THE CHANGED PART OF THE ROUTE USE THE EXISTING STOPS OF OTHER LINES.

title_translations.en: Lines 12, 60, 61, 62, 63, 64, 69 and 71 vmč - Temporary change of routes in Maksima Gorki Street

sections.text:
Autobusi JGSP „Novi Sad“ od 1. septembra saobraćaće po novom redu vožnje, koji u odnosu na letnji red vožnje podrazumeva veći broj polazaka.

O vremenskim korekcijama polazaka korisnici usluga mogu da se informišu u rubrici RED VOŽNJE, kao i putem aplikacije NSMART, te na prodajnim mestima preduzeća.

Od 1. septembra ponovo će na snazi biti polasci koji su u redu vožnje označeni kao „đački“.

text_translations.en:
From September 1, JGSP "Novi Sad" buses will operate according to a new timetable, which, compared to the summer timetable, implies a greater number of departures.

Service users can be informed about time corrections of departures in the section RED VOZNJE, as well as through the NSMART application and at the company's sales points.

From September 1, the departures marked as "pupil" in the timetable will be valid again.
